svg.title: TypeScript type checking benchmark
svg.desc: Wall time and peak resident memory for 19 projects. Arithmetic means of 10 runs, with 3 warmups. tsrs, TypeScript 7.1.0-dev.20261023.1, TypeScript 7.0.2.
svg.text: Namespace `nscloud-ubuntu-24.04-amd64-8x16` (8 vCPU, 16 GB RAM, Linux x64, AMD EPYC). 4 checkers, 8 worker CPUs.
Means per compiler and project; no averaging across projects. Measured 2026-10-23.
